about: Football's defaults, as data (docs/PLAN-start-a-game-gpt.md track L, L1): a sport's standard scoring, categories, lineup slots and locks, and the game specs a sport's Make it a game starts from instead of asking the bot. Stat keys are Football's (src/lib/sports/football.ts): players' and a team defense's in one table, since a key is unique in the sport (a quarterback's interceptions thrown are INT, a defender's DINT, a team defense's DSTINT). The team defense is one line per side (Yahoo's DEF: football.ts's defenseId), its points allowed in Yahoo's brackets (PA0 a shutout ... PA35). Slots take its positions or position groups (ESPN's roster says PK for a kicker). The specs are in the game spec's shape (A1's schema, on the engine branch); slots and categories aren't in that schema yet (L4 adds them), so they're kept beside it for the spec to read.

scoring.source: Yahoo's default league scoring, half-PPR (help.yahoo.com/kb/SLN6489.html): offense, then kickers, then the team defense; 25 passing yards a point, 10 rushing or receiving yards a point, fractions kept

categories.source: Yahoo's football leagues score points, not categories: none by default

slots.source: Yahoo's default roster: QB, 2 WR, 2 RB, TE, a W/R/T flex, K, DEF and 6 bench (15)

season.about: A season-long league: draft a full roster, set a lineup each week, play someone head to head each week.

short.about: One game, a team's next few or a week's slate: everyone drafts a few players, every one of them scores, most points wins.
